glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons when a Nerd Font is installed; nerd or plain forces one set

background.title: Background
background.description: Paint the pane with your terminal's background, as #hex (e.g. #1e2030), since Claude Code draws docked panes on its own grey. Empty keeps Claude Code's.

transcriptDiffs.title: Diffs in the conversation
transcriptDiffs.description: hide: an edit shows one summary line (Updated path (+N -M)) and its diff is in the pane; show: the conversation shows the diffs as Claude Code draws them. ctrl+o always shows them.

transcriptCommands.title: Commands in the conversation
transcriptCommands.description: hide: a long shell command Claude described shows its description instead of the command, and finished "Ran 1 shell command" / "Read 2 files" lines go; show: the conversation shows them as Claude Code draws them. ctrl+o always shows them.

sessionBox.title: Session box
sessionBox.description: show: a SESSION box at the top of the pane with the branch, the model, the effort, the context used and the 5h and 7d usage; hide: no box, and the branch line is back in the CHANGES box.
